voice_description: A gigantic ancient stone golem guardian speaking fluent native Japanese, male monster bass. Extremely deep subterranean chest resonance, a broad hollow stone-cavern timbre, rough rocky vocal folds, crushing authority and huge physical mass. Steady deliberate commands with hard clear consonants. Stern, threatening, battle-ready, never a soft narrator. Controlled low growl under the words, no high-pitched rasp, no cartoon or comical delivery. Natural Japanese intonation. Dry isolated studio speech, no music or background effects, no echo. Preserve intelligibility; the voice itself feels enormous.
text: 汚染生命体を確認。通行は許可しない。これより先は、封鎖区域だ。退け。守りを崩すな。この門は開かせん。彼らを守るため、道は封鎖した。私は、この場所を守り続ける。誰であろうと、通すわけにはいかない。私は、彼らを守れと命じられた。
